scientific_integrity: Exact strict-convexity reduction and autocorrelation identity; asymptotic analytic proof; companion independent numerical cross-checks; scientific comparison is best-knowledge, not proof of absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Linear approximation only; fixed fourth Hardy norm for the asymptotic law; geometric-sum input family; no higher-degree or perturbed-generator stability theorem.
title: A cubic boundary-layer law for linear \(H^4\) approximation to geometric sums
